name: KAHN SHAKER
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-KHSK-34L Kahn Shaker is a heavy-duty horizontal reciprocating shaker engineered specifically for clinical and pathology laboratories. It is essential for providing smooth, powerful, and consistent back-and-forth agitation to mix samples in Kahn racks during critical serological and flocculation tests.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS KAHN SHAKER is a high-torque, horizontal reciprocating platform designed to deliver uniform back-and-forth mechanical agitation for serological and flocculation assays. Its DC motor drive and speed regulator maintain constant strokes per minute, generating reproducible shear-free mixing that accelerates antigen-antibody complex formation in VDRL, RPR and Kahn syphilis tests, Widal typhoid agglutination, Brucella/Proteus febrile antigen panels, and latex-based rheumatoid factor or CRP tests. Doctors, B.Sc/M.Sc students, PhD researchers and clinical chemists rely on it to handle sealed serum/plasma samples, bacterial antigen suspensions, cardiolipin and carbon-particle reagents, phosphate-buffered saline, and diluted patient specimens without altering protein conformation. The heavy-duty powder-coated MS cabinet and adjustable rubber-sleeved rods allow secure clamping of Kahn racks, test tubes, conical flasks and reagent bottles while operating in compliance with CLSI M40-A2, ISO 15189 and WHO serology quality-control guidelines.
sop: Place the shaker on a stable, level, vibration-free bench and connect it to a grounded 220-230V/50Hz power supply.
Load Kahn racks, tubes or flasks symmetrically and secure them with the adjustable steel rods and rubber sleeves; ensure no glassware directly contacts metal parts.
Switch ON the main power and verify that the digital LED RPM display illuminates on the control panel.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value.
Set the timer to the desired duration within 0-999 minutes and press START/STOP; observe smooth horizontal reciprocating motion and adjust speed gradually if needed.
At the end of the run, press STOP, switch OFF the unit, carefully unload samples, and clean the platform with 70% ethanol or 1% sodium hypochlorite.

Safety Warning: Never open the platform guard or insert/remove samples while the shaker is in motion; infectious sera, antigen suspensions, strong acids and volatile organic solvents must remain in tightly sealed secondary containment to prevent aerosol or spill exposure, and always disconnect power before cleaning or maintenance.
features: Smooth Horizontal Reciprocating motion for agitating and blending
Driven by a reliable imported DC motor reaching up to 250 RPM
Digital LED display of RPM on the control panel
Heavy duty metal angle supported powder-coated mild steel cabinet
Adjustable steel rods with rubber sleeves to secure various bottles and flasks

specifications.Cabinet Material: Powder coated MS with heavy-duty metal angles
specifications.Flask Holder: Adjustable Steel rods with rubber sleeve
specifications.Target Applications: Serological mixing, Flocculation tests, General sample blending
